spec_match.rationale: Probes the exact PR 672 contract: prototype's parent === EventTarget.prototype, the three named methods resolving, and resolving by inheritance rather than as own copies — matching the IDL in Chromium CL 7879985.

interactive.rationale: The probe runs on load and a real button re-runs it; results table, verdict banner, aria-live detail and a measured prototype-chain drawing all update from live reads.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The feature index promises four exact checks each capable of returning false; the page delivers exactly those four.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers interface-absent (blocked rows plus a Linux-experimental-flag explanation), pre-157 exposed-but-not-inherited, and the polyfill-posing-as-feature case via the own-property check.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5138797158334464, the PR 672 spec preview, and sibling concepts.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite asserts the same prototype-parent, methods-resolve, inherited-not-own and additive-surface contracts, all guarded to return false honestly when the global is absent; verified executing 0 pass / 7 fail / 1 blocked on this Chromium 141.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141: desktop 1280px and true-360px viewport measured overflow-free; probe verified returning false/blocked honestly; re-run button clicked via same-origin driver with stable results; console clean ([ble-et:probe] logs only).

telemetry_health.rationale: demo-telemetry.js is loaded and inheritance-probed plus the unavailable-branch assertion fire with exposed/inherited detail.

design_system.rationale: Only design-system variables, table wrapped in an overflow-x scroller, button colour pairs from the global rule, verdict colours hit AA on stone/paper.

accessibility.rationale: Single real button, aria-live polite on the detail output and measured chain, caption + th scope on the results table, headings label each stage via aria-labelledby.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Measured html.scrollWidth 360 at a 360px viewport (iframe harness) and screenshotted at 500px and 1280px; single-column stages, 44px button, expression cells wrap with overflow-wrap anywhere inside a scroller.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify the true-branch rendering on a Chrome 157 build
openQuestions.detail: Every check returned false/blocked here because this Chromium 141 has no Web Bluetooth on Linux. When a 157 (or flag-enabled Canary with CL 7879985) build is available, confirm the all-true verdict path, the drawn chain showing the EventTarget hop, and the polyfill-detection check still passing against the real inheritance.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible status updates with aria-live regions for async operations
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Prefer native elements, structure content with landmarks/headings, use semantic tables with caption and th scope, and surface state changes through text/live regions rather than visuals alone.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Results are a real table with caption + scoped headers, the verdict/detail are text updated via an aria-live polite output, and all controls are native buttons.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive form controls layout without horizontal overflow on mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Lean on intrinsic sizing and flex/grid with wrapping; keep wide content scrolling inside its own container instead of widening the page.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Stages are single-column grids, the expression table sits in an overflow-x:auto scroller with overflow-wrap:anywhere cells; verified scrollWidth 360 at a 360px viewport.

summary: Exact-surface probe of the one-line IDL change. On this Linux Chromium 141 (no Web Bluetooth) it honestly reports the interface as absent, distinguishes that from pre-157 non-inheritance, and explains the Linux experimental-flag path without ever saying 'upgrade your browser'.
